name: Wangari Maathai
shortBio: Kenyan environmental philosopher, biologist, Nobel Peace Laureate, and founder of the Green Belt Movement who unified ecological restoration, anti-corruption civic democracy, and African women's empowerment.
centralQuestion: Why are ecological degradation, postcolonial authoritarianism, and rural women's disenfranchisement structurally inseparable?

keyWorks.title: The Green Belt Movement: Sharing the Approach and the Experience
keyWorks.description: Articulates grassroots tree-planting as an integrated praxis of ecological regeneration, civic education, and anti-authoritarian accountability.

keyWorks.title: The Challenge for Africa
keyWorks.description: Philosophical diagnosis of postcolonial governance, cultural reclamation (kibagi/mothertongue), and sustainable African self-determination.
